results.title: Cabo Verde squad announcement | FIFA World Cup 2026
highlights:
Key figures such as Vozinho, Lopes, Mendes and Livramento headline Bubista's squad for World Cup 2026.
[...]
Cabo Verde have announced the squad which will travel to North America for the nation’s maiden FIFA World Cup™.
[...]
Coach Bubista’s selection includes some of the country's most experienced players, such as goalkeeper Vozinha and winger Ryan Mendes. Defender Roberto ‘Pico’ Lopes is also present, as is striker Dailon Livramento, who was decisive in the qualifying campaign.
[...]
Cabo Verde will kick off their campaign in Atlanta against Spain on 15 June. Six days later, the Blue Sharks will travel to Miami to face Uruguay, before they round off their Group H campaign against Saudi Arabia in Houston on 26 June.

results.title: Cape Verde World Cup 2026 team guide - MyJoyOnline
highlights:
Perhaps the only question hanging over the team is the fitness of Logan Costa. The Villarreal centre-back is arguably the one elite player in a team full of nomadic footballers but the French-born defender is yet to play a single minute of football this season after tearing his ACL last summer.
[...]
In 2012, the Leicester scout Steve Walsh travelled to the French club Le Havre where he would discover the future Premier League, Champions League and Afcon winner Riyad Mahrez. At the time, though, Walsh was on his way to see the jewel of the famous academy at the time, Ryan Mendes. Before Leicester signed Mahrez, Mendes joined Lille as a replacement for Eden Hazard. A nasty ankle injury slowed Mendes’s club career but for the Blue Sharks he is perhaps the nation’s greatest player. He is the captain, top scorer, most capped player and at the World Cup is set to become the first centurion in Cape Verdean history. At 36, his star may be waning but is still at the heart of the team. “Ryan's been there for so long and he's been doing it every time he's called upon he shows up and he scores goals,” says the Cape Verde defender Pico Lopes.
[...]
(4-3-3) Vozinha - Steven Moreira, Logan Costa, Pico Lopes, Sidny Cabral - Kevin Pina, Deroy Duarte, Jameiro Monteiro - Ryan Mendes, Dailon Livramento, Jovane Cabral

results.title: World Cup 2026: Cape Verde – the history-making debutants with a hidden superpower - The Mirror
highlights:
While the squad is primarily composed of journeymen playing in Cyprus, Turkey, Russia and Bulgaria, Cape Verde boast one truly top-tier star: Villarreal centre back Logan Costa. Comparable to the best defenders in Europe, Costa is the luxury foundation of the team, but he arrives under a massive injury cloud.
[...]
The catch? Costa tore his ACL in the final game of pre-season, missing almost the entirety of the domestic campaign. "He has played just 45 minutes of football all season, coming on at the very end of Villarreal's final two matches. He is the partner to Willy Kambwala at the back. If he is fully fit and plays well, they have a live chance. If not, it's hard to see them getting anything."
[...]
With aging icon Ryan Mendes expected to feature primarily from the bench at 36, the goalscoring burden has shifted to centre forward Dylon Livermento. Born in Rotterdam to a Cape Verdean music star, Livermento possesses one of the most baffling statistical profiles in international football.

results.title: Cape Verde at the 2026 World Cup: roster, list, players, group and schedule - AS USA
highlights:
The “Blue Sharks” of Cape Verde(Cabo Verde) are entering the 2026 FIFA World Cup as one of the tournament’s ultimate fairy-tale stories, making their historic debut after stunningly topping their qualifying group ahead of African powerhouse Cameroon.
[...]
Managed by Bubista, the tiny Atlantic archipelago nation of just 600,000 people relies on a balanced blend of veteran grit and emerging youth. The squad is anchored by 40-year-old historic goalkeeper Vozinha and 36-year-old captain Ryan Mendes, the nation’s all-time leading goalscorer who remains their emotional and attacking reference point.
[...]
Alongside these veterans, Villarreal’s commanding center-back Logan Costa provides elite technical composure in defense, while 25-year-old forward Dailon Livramento—who led the team with four goals in qualifying—supplies the electric pace and clinical finishing needed to threaten Group H heavyweights Spain, Uruguay, and Saudi Arabia.
[...]
